input.free_text_description: This system is a e-commerce platform that serves Customer, Candidate roles. The platform provides capabilities for order status, order, payment processing. Secondary concerns include job/recommendation functionality.

user_stories.story: As a Customer, I want to securely sign in to the system, so that I can access my personalized resources.
As a Customer, I want to receive notifications about important events, so that I can stay informed and respond promptly.
As an Admin, I want to manage system configuration and monitor operations, so that I can ensure the platform runs smoothly.
As a Customer, I want to add items to my cart and complete a purchase, so that I can buy products conveniently.
As a Customer, I want to interact with restaurant info functionality, so that I can accomplish my restaurant info-related tasks.
